summary: Semantic judgments for the accepted cover unit (湖南农业大学 全日制普通本科生毕业论文(设计) 封面). 16 source entries span university-name header, document-type line, Chinese and English title placeholders, five basic-information lines (student name, student ID, grade/major/class, advisor name + title, department), the fixed 湖南·长沙 location, and the submission date. Per the accepted boundary checkpoint, block 1 (附件1 封面基本格式) is a format preamble outside the cover layout and is judged as cleanup-style instruction text; all parenthetical layout/empty-line/font-size/style instructions embedded as separate source entries are also cleanup. Fixed labels, value-position fill slots, and style-only parenthetical notes are partitioned per source entry; Chinese title binds thesis.title.zh, English title binds thesis.title.en, student name binds author.name.zh, student ID binds author.student_id, grade/major/class binds author.cohort_class, advisor name and advisor title are split into two adjacent fill_slots, department binds author.department, and submission date binds submission.date.

parts.text: 附件1 封面基本格式：单倍行距；上下页边距均为2.54厘米，左右页边距均为2.6厘米；除基本信息的5行内容外，其余内容均居中。“□” 表示占1个字宽（即2个字符）的空格。所做的为论文,则标题中设计不要；所做的为设计,则标题中标题中论文不要。

semantic_judgments.reason: Per the accepted unit-boundary checkpoint, this paragraph sits outside the cover layout itself as a format/style preamble. As a cover unit, the visible text outline starts at the layout cue for the cover; this paragraph is a style-obligation concern, not a cover layout member, and should not appear in the clean fillable template. The title 论文/设计 alternation note is a style obligation that the host style contract carries, not text that belongs in the rendered cover.
Parenthetical layout cue specifying font size, font family, and an empty-line spacer preceding the university name. It is a format instruction, not text that should remain in the rendered cover.

Parenthetical layout cue specifying font size and an empty-line spacer preceding the Chinese title line. Format instruction only; not text that should remain in the rendered cover.

parts.text: 毕业论文（设计）中文题目

semantic_judgments.reason: The label 毕业论文（设计）中文题目 is a fixed cover heading; the surrounding value position for the Chinese title is empty in this entry and is bound as a fill_slot in the immediately following English-title block context via thesis.title.zh. The parenthetical specifies font/size/bold required for the Chinese title value.

The uppercase English title placeholder text occupies the value position of the English title on the cover; it must be replaced by the student's actual English title. The parenthetical specifies font/size/bold/uppercase styling required for that value. thesis.title.zh is carried by the preceding empty-value title slot bounded by the Chinese-title label; thesis.title.en is carried here.

parts.text: （根据题目长短四号字空二或三行）

semantic_judgments.reason: Parenthetical layout cue specifying how many empty lines to leave after the title block depending on title length. Format instruction only; not text that should remain in the rendered cover.

The leading □□□□□□ glyphs are the school-defined one-character-wide indent; the 学生姓名 token is the fixed label; the parenthetical before the colon describes the label font (三号黑体加粗); the colon is a label-value separator that belongs to the label; the ×××（或×□×） text is an example/placeholder occupying the value position and is replaced by the student's Chinese name; the trailing parenthetical specifies font/size/bold for the value.

Leading indent glyphs; 学□□号 is the fixed label (the two internal □ belong to the label token, mirroring the spacing shown in the original template); the colon is a label-value separator; the × placeholder digits form the value position that is replaced by the student's actual student ID.

The school template merges grade, major, and class into a single value position on the cover, matching the vocabulary's author.cohort_class compound field. Leading indent glyphs and the fixed label are preserved; the placeholder 20××级×××（×）班 is the value slot that the compound field replaces.

Leading indent; the 指导老师及职称 token is a combined fixed label that names both fields but does not carry either value. The colon is a separator. The first ××× placeholder is the advisor's name value (advisor.name.zh); the intervening □ is a one-character-wide spacing glyph from the school's spacing convention (not a field value); the trailing 教授 placeholder is the advisor's title value (advisor.title). The two values are adjacent but belong to different fields and must be split.

Leading indent; 学□□院 is the fixed label; colon is the separator; ××××学院 placeholder is the department value position bound to author.department; the trailing parenthetical is a format constraint (use the full department name) that applies to the value, not text to render.
Parenthetical layout cue specifying font size and empty-line spacer preceding the location/date block. Format instruction only; not text that should remain in the rendered cover.
The location 湖南·长沙 is fixed school content (the school's location line on the cover); the parenthetical specifies the required font/size for that fixed line.
The 提交日期 label and colon are fixed cover text; the 20××年××月 placeholder is the value position replaced by the actual submission year/month, bound to submission.date.
